name: academic-students
description: Study toolkit for university and college students (undergraduate, master's and PhD, any degree): coaches you through assignments with hints, checks and group-work splits; estimates the grade a professor would give against the assignment's instructions; helps with academic writing and real citations; turns past exams into practice; summarises lectures; plans your study week; brings in course material from Moodle, Canvas or Blackboard read-only; writes right-to-left languages correctly; and scans course files for hidden AI traps. Never submits work, never answers quizzes, never stores a password.
